title: ipsec: Have a preference to allow bogus padding to pass NULL heuristic
description:
RFC 4303 2.4 is very clear about the padding that MUST be used by
algorithms that don't specifically state a different padding type
in an RFC. NULL encryption MUST use the default padding algorithm.

Unfortunately, it seems that some implementations don't. We didn't
check the padding before 4.0. Add an enum preference to allow all-zero
padding, or even all padding, to still pass the NULL heuristic.
Default to requiring RFC compliant padding, because loosening the
padding restriction increases the number of false positives.

Close #19857
